scope: 15 drone/aerial learned architectures, 3 supporting aerial benchmarks, 1 assisted-navigation boundary case; no manipulator architecture included.

works.title: OpenFly-Agent
works.decision_relevance: History-aware token policy; central reproduction target.
supported_claims: SR 34.3% seen / 22.6% unseen; real-flight SR 26.09% on 23 trials.
works.datasets: OpenFly: about 100k training trajectories, rendered scenes including real-world reconstructions. Official raw and RLDS repositories exist.
works.metrics: Stop within 20 m; collision fails. OSR counts reaching that radius at any point: 64.3% / 56.2%. Seen 1,800 and unseen 1,200 routes.
works.data: OpenFly: about 100k training trajectories, rendered scenes including real-world reconstructions. Official raw and RLDS repositories exist.
works.licenses: Code/model MIT; dataset repositories declare Apache-2.0. Underlying scene assets may have separate terms.
works.compute: 7B; batch 64; real model runs on external PC, with onboard Super trajectory planner and MPC.
works.limitations: v7 paper results are not established for our downloaded checkpoint. Offline action agreement is not flight SR. Do not equate rendered real-scene imagery with real-flight demonstrations.
works.action_interface: Native discrete flight primitives with subset-specific normalization; not our FRD velocity JSON.
works.result: SR 34.3% seen / 22.6% unseen; real-flight SR 26.09% on 23 trials.
works.source_locator: v7 sections 6.1-6.5, Tables 2-3; real-flight appendix I.

works.title: CognitiveDrone
works.decision_relevance: OpenVLA velocity policy, optionally assisted by a reasoning VLM.
supported_claims: Normalized benchmark score 59.6% base / 77.2% R1 reasoning variant.
works.datasets: 8,062 simulated trajectories in Gazebo/ArduPilot; official cognitiveDrone_dataset HF repository verified.
works.metrics: Correct cognitive gate decisions across task categories; this aggregate is not unrestricted outdoor mission success.
works.data: 8,062 simulated trajectories in Gazebo/ArduPilot; official cognitiveDrone_dataset HF repository verified.
works.licenses: No code/data license metadata verified; public accessibility alone is not reuse permission.
works.compute: OpenVLA 7B; LoRA rank 32; 4,000 updates, batch 64, four A100 GPUs; policy 10 Hz, reasoning 2 Hz.
works.limitations: Simulator cognitive tasks; physical-flight performance is not established by these scores. Final model release not verified.
works.action_interface: vx, vy, vz, yaw rate; optional high-level reasoning stream.
works.result: Normalized benchmark score 59.6% base / 77.2% R1 reasoning variant.
works.source_locator: Sections III-V and benchmark results figure.

works.title: RaceVLA
works.decision_relevance: Direct learned velocity policy with real-drone demonstrations.
supported_claims: Real task-category results: visual 79.6%, motion 75.0%, physical 50.0%, semantic 45.5%.
works.datasets: 200 real demonstration episodes, approximately 20k images; official RaceVLA_dataset verified.
works.metrics: 200 real generalization experiments distributed across categories; not the OpenFly route benchmark.
works.data: 200 real demonstration episodes, approximately 20k images; official RaceVLA_dataset verified.
works.licenses: No explicit code/model/data license metadata verified; project links correct stale README HF owner.
works.compute: OpenVLA 7B; LoRA rank 32, 7k steps, single A100. INT8 inference on offboard RTX4090 at 4 Hz.
works.limitations: Its comparison with manipulation OpenVLA category scores is not a matched physical-task comparison. Limited route/task diversity.
works.action_interface: vx, vy, vz, yaw rate to ArduPilot.
works.result: Real task-category results: visual 79.6%, motion 75.0%, physical 50.0%, semantic 45.5%.

works.title: AutoFly
works.decision_relevance: RGB plus learned pseudo-depth action policy.
supported_claims: Simulation overall SR 47.9%, CR 21.9%; real indoor/outdoor SR 60% / 55%.
works.datasets: Custom AirSim and real-flight navigation corpus, around 13k trajectories; complete public data release not verified.
works.metrics: Goal distance <=5 m and alignment <=15 degrees; real result uses 10k simulated +1k real training trajectories.
works.data: Custom AirSim and real-flight navigation corpus, around 13k trajectories; complete public data release not verified.
works.licenses: Code license metadata absent; weight/data licensing unresolved.
works.compute: Prismatic 7B; 80k training steps; distributed offboard model/onboard control deployment.
works.limitations: Not pure zero-shot sim-to-real. Official linked xlsun/AutoFly model API returned 401; usable public weights not verified.
works.action_interface: Tokenized 3D velocity vector; navigation policy plus flight control stack.
works.result: Simulation overall SR 47.9%, CR 21.9%; real indoor/outdoor SR 60% / 55%.
works.source_locator: Tables 2-3; Appendix A.2.1 thresholds and A.3/A.5 deployment.

works.title: AerialVLA / AeroVLA (Xu et al.)
works.decision_relevance: Dual-camera minimal aerial action policy; distinct from the AAAI dialogue paper.
supported_claims: SR 47.96% seen / 56.60% unseen objects / 37.58% unseen maps.
works.datasets: TravelUAV; training annotations in official repository.
works.metrics: TravelUAV/OpenUAV splits; 20 m navigation success. Input includes front/down cameras and a directional prompt.
works.data: TravelUAV; training annotations in official repository.
works.licenses: Code and adapter declare Apache-2.0; inspect underlying dataset/asset terms separately.
works.compute: OpenVLA 7B aerial LoRA; native two-camera and prompt interfaces required.
works.limitations: Unseen objects and unseen maps are different splits. Simulation score does not establish physical landing accuracy; audit directional-hint availability before transfer.
works.action_interface: Forward/vertical/yaw displacement bins and intrinsic landing signal; not metric velocity bins.
works.result: SR 47.96% seen / 56.60% unseen objects / 37.58% unseen maps.

works.title: SpatialFly
works.decision_relevance: Implicit 3D geometry features condition waypoint prediction.
supported_claims: Full-training SR 38.54% seen / 25.46% combined unseen / 13.57% unseen maps.
works.metrics: OpenUAV continuous navigation; keep full-data and 25%-data settings separate.
works.compute: Qwen2.5 3B, CLIP and VGGT encoders; LoRA, eight RTX4090 GPUs.
works.limitations: Different sensor/prompt assumptions from OpenFly; no exact official code/weights verified in paper or targeted search. Real-flight result not established.

works.result: Full-training SR 38.54% seen / 25.46% combined unseen / 13.57% unseen maps.
works.source_locator: Methods and experimental setup; Tables I-III.

works.title: LongFly
works.decision_relevance: Compressed visual history and trajectory history support long routes.
supported_claims: SR 36.39% seen / 43.87% unseen objects / 11.27% unseen maps.
works.metrics: OpenUAV; stop within 20 m. Seen OSR 65.87% is much higher than seen SR.
works.compute: Qwen2.5 3B; LoRA with frozen visual encoder; exact training cost not independently measured.
works.limitations: History and stopping matter; goal-hint access requires audit. No official code/checkpoint verified in targeted search; real-flight validation not established.
works.result: SR 36.39% seen / 43.87% unseen objects / 11.27% unseen maps.

works.title: FLIGHTVLA / Think Like a Pilot
works.decision_relevance: Asynchronous reasoning VLM and diffusion action head.
supported_claims: Long-horizon Flow SR 59.0%; Fine-grained VLN SR 13.5% and instruction-adherence SR 11.0%.
works.datasets: FLIGHT: 6,689 fine-grained VLN and 4,098 long-horizon Flow trajectories.
works.metrics: Flow requires all subtasks; VLN SR uses stop within 15 m; adherence additionally requires the instructed sequence.
works.data: FLIGHT: 6,689 fine-grained VLN and 4,098 long-horizon Flow trajectories.

works.limitations: The two scores are different tasks, not contradictory model performance. Simulation results; final model file availability not established by a dataset link.
works.action_interface: Dense flight trajectory/action chunks conditioned on delayed semantic features.
works.result: Long-horizon Flow SR 59.0%; Fine-grained VLN SR 13.5% and instruction-adherence SR 11.0%.

works.title: WorldVLN
works.decision_relevance: Autoregressive world model with learned action decoding.
supported_claims: UAV-Flow-Sim SR 79.12% fixed-language / 78.02% open-language; IndoorUAV-VLA SR 41.76%.

works.title: ImagineUAV
works.decision_relevance: Video world-action model followed by kinodynamic planning.
supported_claims: Flow-Sim SR 70.9% full / 68.9% distilled; real flights 13/20 with planner versus 9/20 without.
works.datasets: UAV-Flow; real flight evaluation uses an additional planning stack.
works.metrics: Ten real tasks repeated twice; native UAV-Flow-Sim task completion.
works.data: UAV-Flow; real flight evaluation uses an additional planning stack.

works.title: Exp2VLA
works.decision_relevance: Aerial expert demonstrations adapt pi0.5 and SmolVLA action experts.
supported_claims: pi0.5: 84.10% single-object, 65.0% multicolor, 51.7% color-permuted; SmolVLA: 46.60% single-object and 15.0% multicolor.
works.datasets: MultiObject training table: 1,500 episodes / 370,500 timesteps /0.98GB; separate SingleCube dataset.
works.metrics: Isaac Lab, stated 500 episodes/task, 0.60 m goal radius. Equation/algorithm accept any-time radius entry, although prose mentions stabilizing.
works.code: Training pipeline described; a complete official training-code repository not verified.
works.data: MultiObject training table: 1,500 episodes / 370,500 timesteps /0.98GB; separate SingleCube dataset.
works.weights: Final adapted checkpoints not verified; official HF dataset exists.
works.licenses: HF dataset license metadata absent; underlying backbone terms do not grant dataset permissions.
works.compute: Reported pi0.5 run: 60k steps, batch16, BF16, frozen SigLIP; action expert trained.

works.result: pi0.5: 84.10% single-object, 65.0% multicolor, 51.7% color-permuted; SmolVLA: 46.60% single-object and 15.0% multicolor.
